2334-2724-8172.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

1308-2557-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1636-2681-4644-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

4019-4221-5175--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Caged Sun triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
4019-4221-5175--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

876-5833-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more creatures.
876-5833-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Leafkin Druid.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Leafkin Druid.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Leafkin Druid.
Activate Leafkin Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Leafkin Druid.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Leafkin Druid.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Leafkin Druid from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

1115-3259-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
1115-3259-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-7297-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-7297-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7297-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1084-4762-7503.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Elegant Entourage triggers, giving Devoted Druid +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Devoted Druid ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

2104-5144-6991.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Donnie & April and exiling Ephemerate.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

4294-5220-6798.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from Step 3, keeping Etali on the top of your library.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

2743-5726-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-5726-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus an additional {2} due to Thunderclap Drake to select its second mode, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Three Steps Ahead at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Three Steps Ahead spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2829-6972-7157.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1661-3713-4289-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

719-2034-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
719-2034-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-560-3088-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-3534-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3534-5414.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
250-779-1479-3534-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

305-625-1978.description:
Cause Llanowar Tribe to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat from step 2.

198-1978-2734.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-1978-2734.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

1796-2060-4415-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

3532-4985-5078-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-4985-5078-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

3593-4359-4871-5686.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
3593-4359-4871-5686.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

1418-2608-5168--108.easyPrerequisites: You control a copy or clone of Derevi that is legendary and has Derevi's name.
1418-2608-5168--108.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and then choose to return Derevi to the command zone.
Derevi's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Holding priority, activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
1418-2608-5168--108.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any permanent(s) using Derevi's trigger. The card you use to clone / copy Derevi must not bypass the legend rule. The copy must be legendary and have Derevi's name for the legend rule to take effect appropriately.

1274-3490-5231-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1274-3490-5231-6458.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-5231-6458.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-5394-6291.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

803-1238-2351-5147-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

2829-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2829-5776-5777.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

914-2136-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Orthion.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2136-5200.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, and you may then target any other creature using Orthion's ability.

232-732-1636-4102.notablePrerequisites:
Psionic Gift attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
232-732-1636-4102.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

785-3417.notablePrerequisites:
Soul Link attached to Ill-Tempered Loner.
Ill-Tempered Loner can be transformed.
You have a way to give Ill-Tempered Loner indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner.
785-3417.description:
Give Ill-Tempered Loner indestructible, and then deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner.
Ill-Tempered Loner and Soul Link's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Soul Link trigger, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Ill-Tempered Loner trigger, dealing that much damage to itself.
Ill-Tempered Loner and Soul Link's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve both Soul Link triggers, causing you to gain life equal to twice the damage dealt.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-4268-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain one life.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2421-4005-4474.description:
Activate Paradise Mantle's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Syrix.
Activate Syrix by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Paradise Mantle's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Skyfire Phoenix.
Activate Skyfire Phoenix by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Syrix, adding {C}{C}.
Choose not to move Syrix from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
Skyfire Phoenix dies, triggering Syrix, causing you to pay {2}{B}{R} to cast Syrix from your graveyard.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1339-2178-5028-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Arcanis the Omnipotent.
Arcanis the Omnipotent does not have summoning sickness.
1339-2178-5028-5256.description:
Activate Arcanis by tapping it, drawing three cards.
The Locust God triggers three times, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Insect.
Arcanis triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed Insect's power.
Repeat.

1193-2480-3908-4095.notablePrerequisites:
Spark Double is a copy of Tamiyo.
At least four loyalty counters on Spark Double.
There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {5}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
1193-2480-3908-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting anything.
In response, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating copies of Mythos of Illuna that target each permanent besides the original target.
Resolve all copies of Mythos of Illuna including the original, creating token copies of each permanent.
Activate a copy of Tamiyo by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Radiate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate another copy of Tamiyo by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Mythos of Illuna from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the token lands or other mana-producing permanents created in step 3 by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
Repeat, doubling the number of copies created in step 3 each repetition.
Once you have infinite nonlegendary copies of Tamiyo, you may activate Tamiyo abilities any number of times.

224-433-573.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.
